children: Safe has opened beta early access to shielded transactions with Bermuda for professional teams. Bermuda is a compliant privacy solution funded by Gnosis. A Privacy Design Partner Program is also opening to test the transactions against real workflows.

The beta extends Safe's wallet into private treasury operations, adding a privacy-focused use case for professional teams. Testing against real workflows gives the program a practical focus: assessing how shielded transactions fit the treasury work these teams already perform. For SAFE, this product development adds a privacy-driven dimension to its adoption thesis, while the early-access stage keeps the focus on testing the proposed use case.
to test shielded transactions with threshold-based control.
It's in beta, and we're opening a Safe Privacy Design Partner Program to test it against real workflows.

title: Safe: Shielded transactions with Bermuda enter beta early access - 03 Oct 2026
